BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   D. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   C. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   B. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   B. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   D. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   D. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   D. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

14. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.

15. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   B. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
